description: This file defines the class AttachmentsRepo which manages storing, retrieving, and deleting attachment files in the app's private storage. It handles writing data from a URI to internal storage, generating content URIs for stored files, and listing or deleting stored attachments.

classes.name: AttachmentsRepo
classes.description: A utility class for managing attachment files within app's private storage, including writing files from URIs, listing stored files, and deleting all stored files.

methods.name: AttachmentsRepo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the repository with application context and setting up the attachments directory.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Reads content from the provided URI, saves it as a file in internal storage, and returns a URI pointing to the saved file.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all attachment files stored in the attachments directory.

methods.name: getAllUris
methods.description: Returns a list of URIs referencing all stored attachment files.

methods.name: getUriForFile
methods.description: Generates a content URI for a specific file using FileProvider.
